About

Not a clinic

Severe eczema or an existing egg allergy needs a clinician before peanut. Breathing trouble after a food is an emergency.

Start here

What first foods are really for

In the second half of the first year, food is there for iron, energy, and learning to eat. It is not about hitting a protein percentage.

When to start

The right window opens after four months and runs to about six. Readiness is about skills, but there is still a minimum age.

What to introduce, and when

There is no set calendar for which vegetable comes when. There is a good reason to bring in allergens early and keep them in the diet.

Introducing allergens

Delaying peanut, egg, and milk doesn’t prevent allergy. For most babies, the safer plan is to start them in a safe texture and keep them coming.

Picky eating

Being wary of new food is a normal toddler stage. Your child’s growth, not today’s plate, tells you when to ask for help.

When your child is ill

Familiar food, enough fluids, and the usual milk feeds. A sick day is the wrong day to decide on an allergy or try a new food.
